name: SparkyFitness
why: Self-hosted fitness tracker that logs nutrition, exercise and body metrics and names MyFitnessPal as the app it replaces.
coreLoopCovered: Food logging with calories and macros, exercise and body metrics on your own server. Food database is smaller than MyFitnessPal's.

name: OpenNutriTracker
why: Open-source mobile app that logs food and drink against calorie and macro targets.
coreLoopCovered: Meal logging with a barcode scanner and daily macro rings on a phone. No server or sync to other devices.

name: Waistline
why: Libre Android calorie counter and weight tracker that looks up products in Open Food Facts and USDA data.
coreLoopCovered: Calorie and weight logging with barcode lookups against open food data. Android only, no server.

name: Open Food Facts
why: Open barcode-indexed food database and the server that runs it.
coreLoopCovered: The open food database behind barcode lookups. It is data and an API, not a meal diary with targets.

name: wger
why: Self-hosted workout and nutrition manager with a REST API.
coreLoopCovered: Workout logging plus a nutrition diary with calorie plans. Food database coverage is smaller.

name: Daily Value
why: Static web nutrition tracker with a food diary, barcode scanning and USDA and Open Food Facts data, described as a MyFitnessPal alternative.
coreLoopCovered: Food diary with macros, micronutrients and barcode lookup in the browser. Single-device web page with no server sync; very new project.
